name: notification-stack
title: Notification Stack
description: A pile of notifications that fans out on hover or focus. Swipe, click or press Delete to dismiss; the remaining cards close the gap.

props.name: notifications
props.description: Initial notifications, newest first: { id, app, title, body, time, icon? }. The stack tracks dismissals itself.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called after a notification has been swiped, clicked or deleted away.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the stack and label of the list.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the stack takes to fan out and a dismissed card to leave.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
